summary: Chaince Digital Holdings filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026 disclosing a September 21, 2026 Warrant Repurchase Cancellation and Release Agreement with four holders of warrants from its November 30, 2023 private placement. The company repurchased and permanently canceled all outstanding warrants for aggregate cash consideration of US$2.0 million; no shares were issued and none had been exercised, leaving zero warrants outstanding. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch for the resulting capital-structure simplification, any residual dilution overhang removal, and the company's next financing or use-of-cash signal.
